example.result: The closed vocabulary of allowed ground-truth verification states.

semantic_role.definition: Identify the function the source value performs in its enclosing semantic structure.

referent.definition: Identify the concept, object, state, rule, artifact, actor, field, or construct denoted by the source value in context.

relationship_to_parent.definition: Explain how the source value semantically relates to its immediate enclosing key.

example.result: Supplies the value set for the parent field ground_truth_status.value.

semantic_contribution.definition: State the distinct meaning, constraint, distinction, or information this source value contributes to its complete signature and surrounding document.

example.result: Constrains ground-truth results to five explicitly distinguished states.

semantic_class.definition: Classify the kind of semantic object represented by the source value in context using the most specific meaningful class supported by the signature.

ground_truth_status_explainer.classification: ground_truth_status is a closed five-state semantic enumeration.

states.VERIFIED: Direct authoritative evidence supports the complete claim.
states.CONTRADICTED: Authoritative evidence directly conflicts with the complete claim.
states.PARTIAL: Only part of the complete claim is supported by authoritative evidence.
states.UNKNOWN: The authoritative source is unavailable, ambiguous, or unresolved.
states.NOT_EXECUTED: Live authoritative evidence establishes that the claimed action did not occur.

ground_truth_status_explainer.instruction: Preserve all five distinctions exactly; PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, and NOT_EXECUTED are not success states.

count_array_nonempty_items.definition_of_empty: element signature whose terminal node is an empty object {} or an empty array []

doRecord_withReturnSchema.iterate_filename: note: do not save any results to public variables, write batches to compression encryption type files and record each resulting archive filename in batch_archive_filenames. Use glossary for the meaning of each evaluation type. Do: for each element found in original_array_filename, if the terminal node of the element signature is an empty object {} or an empty array [], next on original_array_filename array, else, evaluate the source element in context once for every type in semantic_evaluations. Return one object whose outer key is JSON.stringify(the complete source element exactly as parsed) and whose outer value contains exactly the semantic_evaluations keys in listed order, each mapped to a non-empty string. Example: {"<JSON.stringify(source element)>":{"definition":"...","semantic_role":"...","referent":"...","relationship_to_parent":"...","semantic_contribution":"...","semantic_class":"..."}}. Preserve source order. At end verify no empty indices, each outer key exactly matches the corresponding source signature, every evaluation key is present exactly once in listed order, and every evaluation result is non-empty.

combine_and_send_batch_archives.do: combine all batch archives referenced by batch_archive_filenames in order into one complete batch archive, then send the complete batch archive with the next message to the same destination used by the reading room finale
